title: Bulk I4/mcm reference energy
action: Construct the 20-atom conventional cell of CsPbI3 in the I4/mcm phase using the public crystallographic data. Perform a self-consistent DFT calculation with the PBEsol functional to obtain the total energy of the bulk reference cell.

title: Born effective charges on cubic Pm-3m
action: Construct the ideal cubic Pm-3m unit cell of CsPbI3. Compute Born effective charge tensors for all atoms using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) with the PBEsol functional.

title: Relax HT twin supercell
action: Build a 200-atom supercell containing two mechanically compatible head-to-tail (HT) 90° ferroelastic twin boundaries. Relax the atomic positions using DFT with PBEsol until forces are below a suitable convergence threshold.

title: Relax HH twin supercell
action: Build a 200-atom supercell containing two mechanically compatible head-to-head (HH) 90° ferroelastic twin boundaries. Relax the atomic positions analogously to the HT case using DFT with PBEsol.

title: Analyze wall properties and output results
action: From the relaxed HT and HH supercells, the bulk reference energy, and the Born effective charges, compute: (1) wall formation energies per unit area; (2) wall thickness via fitting the octahedral tilt magnitude profile across the wall; (3) layer‑resolved polarization using the effective charges and ionic displacements and extract the peak in‑plane polarization. Write the six quantities to a JSON file.
description: JSON file containing the computed wall formation energies, thicknesses, and peak in‑plane polarization for both HT and HH twin boundaries.
output_schema:
{
  "HT_formation_energy_mJ_m2": float,
  "HH_formation_energy_mJ_m2": float,
  "HT_thickness_nm": float,
  "HH_thickness_nm": float,
  "HT_peak_polarization_muC_cm2": float,
  "HH_peak_polarization_muC_cm2": float
}
